current_program:
FONTBAKERY_BOOTSTRAP_ROOT=$PWD
conda create --yes --name fontbakery-dev python=3.10 pip
source /opt/conda/etc/profile.d/conda.sh
conda activate fontbakery-dev
python -m pip install --upgrade pip wheel 'setuptools<71'
python -m pip install 'setuptools_scm[toml]>=6.2' meson ninja
python -m pip install --no-build-isolation 'opentype-sanitizer>=9.1.0,==9.*'
python -m pip install --editable '.[tests,docs]' glyphsLib GitPython
cd "$FONTBAKERY_BOOTSTRAP_ROOT"
unset FONTBAKERY_BOOTSTRAP_ROOT
